name: health-sync
description: Pull fresh messages from a set of health-related Telegram chats (medicine, supplements, longevity, fasting) into an Obsidian vault. Incremental and idempotent by message id, and the manual counterpart of the weekly job. Triggers: "/health-sync", "pull the health chats".
